CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS records_state_rows (
           ledger text NOT NULL, key text NOT NULL, payload text NOT NULL, version bigint NOT NULL,
           updated_at bigint NOT NULL, updated_by text NOT NULL, origin_host text NOT NULL, epoch bigint NOT NULL,
           PRIMARY KEY (ledger, key))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS records_append_rows (
           seq bigserial PRIMARY KEY, ledger text NOT NULL, at bigint NOT NULL, payload text NOT NULL,
           origin_host text NOT NULL, epoch bigint NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS records_append_rows_ledger ON records_append_rows (ledger, seq)

CREATE UNIQUE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS records_append_rows_idempotency
           ON records_append_rows (ledger, ((payload::jsonb) ->> 'idempotencyKey'))

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS records_row_changes (
           seq bigserial PRIMARY KEY, ledger text NOT NULL, key text NOT NULL, version bigint NOT NULL,
           payload text, at bigint NOT NULL, epoch bigint NOT NULL)
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS records_row_changes_ledger ON records_row_changes (ledger, seq)

CREATE TABLE IF NOT EXISTS records_store_epoch (
           id smallint PRIMARY KEY CHECK (id = 1), epoch bigint NOT NULL, floor bigint NOT NULL)
INSERT INTO records_store_epoch (id, epoch, floor) VALUES (1, 1, 0) ON CONFLICT (id) DO NOTHING
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS records_ix_6dd0fe800114 ON records_state_rows (ledger, ((payload::jsonb) -> 'color'))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS records_ix_64c65374dbab ON records_state_rows (ledger, ((payload::jsonb) -> 'label'))
CREATE INDEX IF NOT EXISTS records_ix_579233b2c479 ON records_state_rows (ledger, ((payload::jsonb) -> 'owner'))
